summary: Core Corollary5.2 divergence bound is contradicted by a norm-bounded two-layer GCN construction; HSIC normalization inconsistency is Minor.

problems.claim: Corollary5.2 bounds cross-client HdeltaH distance and supports improved generalization from reduced edge weights
problems.suspect_step: Hard disagreement replaced by smooth score gap; entrywise L1 incorrectly bounded by sqrt(rank)*Frobenius
problems.check: Two admissible classifiers disagree on all nodes of k and none of l, with no threshold ties; evaluate printed bound using valid uniform norms
problems.counterevidence: Empirical accuracy gains not refuted. Theorem5.1's triangle-inequality step can hold conditional on imported base lemma. Self-loop convention changes do not remove contradiction.
problems.impact: False graph-specific bound directly underlies core theoretical generalization-improvement claim
problems.correction: Requires new discrepancy/margin conditions and correct norm bounds; degrees must be recomputed when reweighting
problems.repair_verification: No complete replacement theorem; algebraic norm correction only

problems.claim: Eq11 dependence loss is the Eq10 HSIC estimator
problems.counterevidence: At fixed N positive rescaling can be absorbed into lambda; no wrong optimizer or experimental harm established; code unavailable
problems.impact: Ambiguous normalization/effective regularization, especially across unequal client sizes
problems.correction: Use Eq10 scaling or explicitly define a different scaling/coefficient
problems.repair_verification: Arithmetic only; no historical implementation repair

unresolved_claims.reason: Linear HSIC only tests covariance; Z and Z^2 give zero despite dependence, and constant biased encoder is degenerate. Paper mainly states causal inspiration, not a formal identification theorem.
No explicit evaluator update, omitted lambda in pseudocode gradients, and unclear training/round nesting; no code failure inferred

limitations: No complete theorem repair or later erratum search
